verse.verse_3: and those who recite the Remembrance
verse.verse_5: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and of all that is between them; the Lord of the Easts.
verse.verse_6: We have adorned the lower heaven with the adornment of the planets,
verse.verse_7: a protection against every rebel satan;
verse.verse_8: so they cannot listen to the High Assembly, for they are pelted from every side.
verse.verse_9: They are rejected and theirs is an everlasting punishment;
verse.verse_10: except such as snatches a fragment, and he is pursued by a piercing flame.
verse.verse_11: So ask them, are they stronger in constitution, or those whom We have created. We have created them of sticky clay.
verse.verse_12: No, you marvel, while they scoff.
verse.verse_13: When they are reminded, they do not remember.
verse.verse_14: When they are shown a sign, they scoff at it
verse.verse_15: and say: 'This is nothing but clear sorcery'
verse.verse_16: What, when we are dead and become dust and bones, shall we be resurrected.
verse.verse_17: What, and our forefathers, the ancients'
verse.verse_19: It will be but one Shout, then see, they are watching
verse.verse_20: and they will say: 'Woe for us. This is the Day of Recompense'
verse.verse_21: This is the Day of Decision which you belied.
verse.verse_22: Gather together the evildoers, their wives, and that they were worshipping,
verse.verse_23: other than Allah, and guide them to the Path of Hell!
verse.verse_24: And halt them so that they may be questioned.
verse.verse_25: 'Why do you not help one another?
verse.verse_26: No, today they will resign themselves in submission,
verse.verse_27: and approach each other with questions,
verse.verse_28: saying: 'You used to come to us from the right hand'
verse.verse_29: But they reply: 'Rather, you were not believers.
verse.verse_30: We had no authority over you, but you were an insolent nation.
verse.verse_31: The statement of Our Lord is realized against us, and we are tasting it,
verse.verse_32: we perverted you, indeed, we were perverts'
verse.verse_33: Therefore, on that Day they will all share Our punishment.
verse.verse_34: As such We shall deal with the evildoers.
verse.verse_35: For when it was said to them: 'There is no god except Allah' they were always proud
verse.verse_36: and said: 'Are we to renounce our gods for the sake of a mad poet'
verse.verse_37: No, indeed, he has brought the truth, and confirmed the Messengers.
verse.verse_38: You shall certainly taste the painful punishment:
verse.verse_39: but you shall not be recompensed except for what you were doing.
verse.verse_40: But for the sincere worshipers of Allah,
verse.verse_41: there is waiting for them a known provision;
verse.verse_42: fruits. And they are receivers of generosity
verse.verse_44: sitting face to face upon couches,
verse.verse_45: a goblet from a spring shall be passed round to them
verse.verse_46: white, a delight to the drinkers,
verse.verse_47: there is neither sickness in it, nor intoxication.
verse.verse_48: And with them will be maidens (houris) who restrain their wide glances
verse.verse_49: as if they were hidden pearls.
verse.verse_50: They will go to one another asking each other questions.
verse.verse_51: One of them will say: 'I had a companion
verse.verse_52: who would say: "Are you among the believers (of the resurrection)?
verse.verse_53: When we are dead and turned to dust and bones, shall we be recompensed?"
verse.verse_54: And he will reply: 'Are you looking down (into Hell)'
verse.verse_55: Then, he will look and see him in the midst of Hell.
verse.verse_56: 'By Allah' he will say, 'you almost destroyed me!
verse.verse_57: But for the Favor of Allah I should have surely been among those who were arraigned (with you in Hell).
verse.verse_58: What then, shall we not die
verse.verse_59: except our first death, and shall we not be punished'
verse.verse_60: Indeed, this is the mighty victory,
verse.verse_61: and for the like of this let the workers work.
verse.verse_62: Is this a better hospitality or the tree of AzZakkum!
verse.verse_63: We have made this (tree) a trial for the evildoers.
verse.verse_64: It is a tree that grows from the bottom of Hell;
verse.verse_65: its spathes are like the heads of satans
verse.verse_66: on it they shall feed, and with it they shall fill their bellies.
verse.verse_67: On top of it they shall have a brew of boiling water,
verse.verse_68: then their return is to Hell.
verse.verse_69: They found their fathers in error,
verse.verse_70: yet they run in their footsteps,
verse.verse_71: yet before them most of the ancients went astray,
verse.verse_72: though We had sent among them warners.
verse.verse_73: See then the end of those who were warned,
verse.verse_74: except the sincere worshipers of Allah.
verse.verse_75: Noah called to Us, and We are the Best to answer.
verse.verse_76: We saved him and his people from the great distress,
verse.verse_77: and We made his offspring the survivors.
verse.verse_78: And We let it remain upon him in the latter:
verse.verse_79: 'Peace be upon Noah among all the worlds'
verse.verse_80: As such We recompense the gooddoers,
verse.verse_81: he was one of Our believing worshipers.
verse.verse_84: (Remember when) he came to his Lord with a pure heart;
verse.verse_85: and when he said to his father and to his nation: 'What do you worship?
verse.verse_86: It is falsehood that you desire gods other than Allah!
verse.verse_87: What do you think of the Lord of the Worlds'
verse.verse_88: He cast a glance at the stars
verse.verse_89: and said: 'Surely, I am sick (of what you worship)'
verse.verse_90: But they turned their backs and went away from him.
verse.verse_91: Then he turned to their gods, and said: 'What do you eat?
verse.verse_92: What is the matter with you, that you do not speak'
verse.verse_93: And he turned upon them striking them with the right hand.
verse.verse_94: Thereafter they (the people) came to him in haste.
verse.verse_95: He said: 'Do you worship what you, yourselves have carved
verse.verse_96: when it is Allah who created you and all that you do'
verse.verse_97: They replied: 'Build for him a building and cast him into the fire'
verse.verse_98: Their desire was to outwit him, but We made them to be the humiliated.
verse.verse_99: He said: 'I will go to my Lord; He will guide me.
verse.verse_100: My Lord, grant me a righteous (son)'
verse.verse_101: And We gave him the glad tidings of a very gentle son (Ishmael).
verse.verse_102: And when he reached the age of traveling with him, he said: 'My son, while I was sleeping I saw that I shall slaughter (sacrifice) you, tell me what is your opinion' He replied: 'Father, do as you are ordered (by Allah). Allah willing, you shall find me one of those who are steadfast'
verse.verse_103: And when they had both submitted, and his son had laid down prostrate upon his forehead,
verse.verse_104: We called to him, saying: 'O Abraham,
verse.verse_105: you have confirmed your vision' As such We recompense the gooddoers.
verse.verse_106: That was indeed a clear trial.
verse.verse_107: So, We ransomed him with a mighty sacrifice,
verse.verse_108: and We let it (the beautiful praise) remain upon him in the latter (generations),
verse.verse_110: As such We recompense the gooddoers.
verse.verse_111: He was one of Our believing worshipers.
verse.verse_112: Then, We gave him the glad tidings of Isaac, a Prophet, one of the righteous,
verse.verse_113: and We blessed him and Isaac, and from their offspring are some gooddoers, and others who clearly wronged themselves.
verse.verse_114: We also favored Moses and Aaron
verse.verse_115: and We saved them with their nation from a great distress.
verse.verse_116: We helped them, and they became victorious,
verse.verse_117: and We gave them the Clear Book,
verse.verse_118: and guided them upon the Straight Path.
verse.verse_119: And We let it (the beautiful praise) remain upon on both of them in the latter (generations),
verse.verse_121: As such We recompense the gooddoers.
verse.verse_122: They were among Our believing worshipers.
verse.verse_123: And Elias (El Yaseen) was among the Messengers.
verse.verse_124: He asked his people: 'Do you not fear (Allah)?
verse.verse_125: Do you call on Ba'lan (the idol Baal) and abandon the Best Creator,
verse.verse_126: Allah is your Lord and the Lord of your fathers, the ancients'
verse.verse_127: But they belied him, so they will be among the arraigned (in Hell),
verse.verse_128: except the sincere worshipers of Allah.
verse.verse_129: And We let it (the beautiful praise) remain upon him in the latter (generations),
verse.verse_131: As such We recompense the gooddoers.
verse.verse_132: He was among Our believing worshipers.
verse.verse_133: Lot, too, was among the Messengers.
verse.verse_134: We saved him and all his kinsmen,
verse.verse_135: except an old woman who lingered,
verse.verse_137: You pass by them in the morning
verse.verse_138: and at night, will you not understand?
verse.verse_139: Jonah, too, was one of the Messengers.
verse.verse_140: He ran away to the laden ship,
verse.verse_141: and cast lots, and he was among the losers (of the lots that were cast).
verse.verse_142: So the whale swallowed him, for he was blameworthy,
verse.verse_143: and had he not been among those who exalt (Allah),
verse.verse_144: he would have lingered in its belly till the Day they are resurrected.
verse.verse_145: But We cast him, upon the shore, and he was ill,
verse.verse_146: and We caused a pumpkin tree to grow over him.
verse.verse_147: Then We sent him to a hundred thousand or more,
verse.verse_148: and they believed, and We gave them enjoyment for awhile.
verse.verse_149: Now, ask them, has your Lord daughters, and they sons?
verse.verse_150: Or, did We create the angels females while they were witnessing?
verse.verse_151: Then is it of their lying that they say:
verse.verse_152: 'Allah has begotten' They are truly liars.
verse.verse_153: Has He chosen daughters above sons?
verse.verse_154: What is the matter with you? How do you judge?
verse.verse_156: Or, do you have a clear authority?
verse.verse_157: Bring your Book, if what you say is true!
verse.verse_158: They assert kinship between Him and the angels. But the angels know that they (the liars) will be arraigned (in Hell).
verse.verse_159: Exaltations to Allah above what they describe,
verse.verse_160: except for the sincere worshipers of Allah.
verse.verse_161: But as for you, and that you worship,
verse.verse_162: you shall tempt none against Him
verse.verse_163: except for he who shall roast in Hell.
verse.verse_164: (Gabriel said to the Prophet): 'Each of us has a known place.
verse.verse_165: We are surely those who are arranged in ranks.
verse.verse_166: And we are they who exalt (Allah)'
verse.verse_168: 'If only we had a reminder from the ancients,
verse.verse_169: we would have been sincere worshipers of Allah'
verse.verse_170: But they disbelieve in it (the Koran), but soon they shall know!
verse.verse_171: Our Word had already preceded Our worshipers, the Messengers,
verse.verse_172: that they shall receive Our help
verse.verse_173: and Our armies shall be the victors.
verse.verse_174: So turn (away) from them for a while.
verse.verse_175: See them and soon they shall see.
verse.verse_176: What, do they seek to hasten Our punishment?
verse.verse_177: When it descends upon their courtyards, evil will be the morning of those forewarned.
verse.verse_178: So turn (away) from them for a while,
verse.verse_179: and see, soon they shall see!
verse.verse_180: Exaltations be to your Lord, the Lord of Might, above that they describe!
verse.verse_182: And praise belongs to Allah, Lord of the Worlds.
